brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Record coca crops in Bolivia feed a growing global cocaine demand. [2]
Bolivia's gas reserves are running out, raising questions about the country's economic future. [3]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR BOLIVIA
The record coca crops and growing global cocaine demand may increase Bolivia's exposure to US and Canada sanctions, as it is already linked to 4 sanctions designations. [2][E2]
As its gas runs out, Bolivia's net energy import dependency of 0% offers no buffer against the loss of export revenue. [3][E3]

KEY RISKS
Bolivia's 4 US and Canada sanctions designations create a risk of further financial restrictions. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
It remains to be seen whether Bolivia can avoid repeating history as its gas reserves run out. [3]
